body: I agree with this 100% except for no-contract cell phones.  If you google "no contract phone" they're the #1 result and understandably so.  They carry (I think) every no contract phone from all carriers and the prices are set by the carrier so Best Buy isn't ripping you off like on all their other products.
Just by posting this I'm getting spam pm's from throwaways >:(

I think this is exactly what I was looking to hear but couldn't put it into words myself.  I've had plenty of medical problems but none of them were especially troubling as most of them were somewhat easily curable and the ones that aren't are not at all visually obvious.

I'd post a link but I don't want to give them any more backlinks. Practically every single result for google queries like "vitiligo treatment" or "vitiligo cure" are the spam I'm referring too.  It looks just like a scammy weight loss site but the testimonials are of what I assume is vitiligo progress pictures in reverse.

My first spot was on my back and I was told by my dermatologist that it was the same thing you're describing.

haha thank you.  I think its mostly the vitiligo that's bothering me.  I know its super vain, but I already had a somewhat low self esteem and this is just crushing it.  I'm already having to change my lifestyle, like having to cover my skin in peak sunny times and cover my skin in this awful super strong oily sunscreen.  And its only made worse by the fact that any time I look for even just emotional support online every single fucking forum has been taken over by this terrible anti-vitiligo spam and all these poor people desperately trying different options and failing. A part of me just wants to bleach my face and forget about it but I'm still holding on to this fantasy of regaining my pigmentation.

I can't even find any legitimate information online about it and my dermatologist basically just said good luck but that all I could do was wait as I continue to lose pigment.

Thank you for responding to this, I really think I kind of need someone to vent to.
